calls.question: Will the ICE BofA US High Yield Index Option-Adjusted Spread be wider in 30 days than it is today?
calls.forecast: High-yield spreads likely widen modestly over 30 days.
calls.resolutionCriteria: YES if FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2 in 30 days is higher than today. NO if equal or lower.

calls.question: Will US-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs register net inflows over the next 7 days?
calls.forecast: US spot bitcoin ETFs likely see net outflows over 7 days.
calls.resolutionCriteria: YES if the 7-day sum of US spot bitcoin ETF flows is positive. NO if zero or negative.

calls.question: Will the CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) be higher in 30 days than its trailing 3-month average?
calls.forecast: VIX is about even to finish above its 3-month average.
calls.resolutionCriteria: YES if the VIX close in 30 days is above the average of the prior 90 daily closes. NO otherwise.

calls.question: Will a major hyperscaler or AI lab announce a new dedicated power-generation or power-purchase agreement for AI/data-center capacity within 30 days?
calls.forecast: A major lab or hyperscaler likely announces a new power deal within 30 days.
calls.resolutionCriteria: YES if Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Oracle, xAI, or OpenAI announces a new power contract within 30 days. NO if none does.
